evidence: All five dimension prompts (gates/render, gates/constraints, scored/functional, scored/polish, scored/visual prompt.md line 1) name 'the live Colderwater playground at http://localhost:3000' and inject {app_context}; app_context.md:1-14 describes this app only: name Colderwater playground, port 3000, no accounts (matches instruction.md:5 'without signing in' and policy.md:3), one workspace at / with title/filename, editor Undo/Redo/Format/Find/Replace, line/column readout, Run/Stop/New/Save, preview, console, library and revision history (matches ui.md:5-17 and instruction.md). Health route app_context.md:27 matches test.sh probe (127.0.0.1:3000/api/health). Grep of tests/, instructions and instruction.md for sibling residue (hireops, ballot, recruit, candidate, invoice, tenant, login, password, admin, coldwater misspelling, TODO, lorem, example.com) found only the intentional 'no sign-in' statements. Every special-case note maps to a real criterion: public https address -> functional judge.toml:326 (preview isolation); replay -> :380; localStorage entry -> :326; storage clearing/two tabs -> :344/:353/:362; restart_app -> functional prompt.md:33 and judge.toml:344 + [[judge.mcp_servers]] restart_mcp.py; canvas/emoji/combining-accent notes -> :47, :173, :182. Dimension-specific scopes are consistent: polish/visual forbid script state changes and none of their criteria need the three allowed uses. New bullet app_context.md:21 checked against the actual tool set: tools/list from playwright-mcp 0.0.79 (version pinned in tests/Dockerfile:19; same args as judge.toml '--headless --isolated --executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium --no-sandbox') shows browser_click properties [element, target, doubleClick, button, modifiers] with modifiers enum [Alt, Control, ControlOrMeta, Meta, Shift] and no position field, browser_press_key, and browser_run_code_unsafe whose code is invoked with page. So 'pass the modifier in its modifiers option', 'page.keyboard.down / page.mouse.click / page.keyboard.up' in the code runner, and 'a click on an element without a position lands at its centre' are all accurate for this harness; Playwright applies keys held through keyboard.down to subsequent mouse events. The bullet agrees with ui.md:9 (Alt+Click and Ctrl/Cmd+Click add carets) and with functional criteria cw_multi_caret_typing_atomic (:96-101), cw_multi_caret_delete (:105-110), cw_same_line_carets (:114-119) ('Fails if either modifier-click does not add a caret'); it adds no requirement and does not relax any failure condition. Broken-app probe: an app without multi-caret still gets no added caret under a properly held modifier and fails as before. Conforming-alternative probe: an app reading altKey/ctrlKey/metaKey on mousedown/click receives the modifier via either documented route, so the bullet removes a harness-induced false negative rather than creating one. Limitations: the tool schema was read from local image cw-editor-verifier:current (same pinned MCP version), not an image built from the frozen bytes; no raw-evidence-index.json exists for this run; no hosted or local judge run after the bullet was added was measured, so whether the three multi-caret criteria now pass under the Oracle is NOT EXERCISED here (outside this row's scope; it belongs to runtime/oracle rows).
